turns.text: Task: In httpx/_decoders.py, add a helper function supported_encodings() -> list[str] that returns sorted(SUPPORTED_DECODERS.keys()). Add unit tests for supported_encodings in tests/test_decoders.py verifying it returns a sorted list containing 'identity', 'gzip', and 'deflate'. Constraints: use only your file read and file edit tools, and the single shell command: py -3.11 -m pytest --noconftest -o filterwarnings=default -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_decoders.py -q (run it at the end). Do not run any other shell command.
